assembly.context_codec: canonical Certificate v0 bytes in lowercase hex chunks <=65536 characters; full decoded certificate <=2097152 bytes; imports bind exact checked foundation exports; source_manifest absent; no axiom/theory primitive/new trusted rule
assembly.hash_preimage: all fields except assembly_hash, including full context bytes and exact source/IR/contract/definition/member tables; no VC/skeleton/certificate-manifest/receipt ref
assembly.statement_rule: whole assembly_hash plus request_hash selects exact name and type_term_id in the bound term table; declaration_hash uses the existing Certificate v0 declaration_interface_hash, which alone does not bind the term table
assembly.table_rule: all context tables/declarations are an exact prefix of the final proof certificate; proof terms/theorems append, never replace or renumber the context

families.coverage: independent source interpreter, all prefixes and all completion kinds
families.reject: replace source AST by the emitted IR or assume correspondence
families.signature: SourceWF(f) and IRWF(f) and forall e,s. EntryRep(f,e,s) -> Correspond(f,e,s)

families.reject: assume caller fit, separation, no-wrap or copied-list slice semantics
families.signature: forall e. AdmittedEntry(f,e) -> exists s. EntryRep(f,e,s)

families.coverage: own clause excluded; ordered earlier requires and short-circuit guards only
families.reject: use the clause being checked, its result or an unproved invariant

families.coverage: every normal return, exact positional/named results and entry old-state
families.reject: drop early return, permute tuple members or read old from the final heap
families.signature: forall e,s,o. Pre(f,e) and Run(f,e,s,o) and Normal(o) -> Defined(c,e,o) and Holds(c,e,o)

families.coverage: every reachable prefix, borrowed inputs and exact write permissions
families.reject: allow an input write because the original value is restored on return
families.signature: forall e,s,p. Pre(f,e) and EntryRep(f,e,s) and Reach(f,s,p) -> Frame(f,e,p)

families.coverage: all paths, runtime safety and domain obligations; divergence allowed
families.reject: interpret finite proof fuel as termination, falsehood or source panic
families.signature: forall e,s. Pre(f,e) and EntryRep(f,e,s) -> SafePrefixes(f,s) and NormalPost(f,e,s)

families.coverage: actual normal termination plus separately required partial correctness
families.reject: use a finite slice length or the partial contract as a termination axiom
families.signature: forall e,s. Pre(f,e) and EntryRep(f,e,s) -> exists o. Run(f,e,s,o) and Normal(o)

families.coverage: exact concrete member of the independently regenerated 56-operation table
families.reject: substitute a different node, member ordinal, operation or free predicate

families.coverage: full address arithmetic, typed owner/view, domain and permissions
families.reject: truncate addresses or omit an access point/initialized tail

families.coverage: evaluated receiver/arguments from one invocation; actual callee and contract
families.reject: assume a callee precondition or evaluate an argument twice
families.signature: forall e,s. ReachCall(f,node,e,s) -> Defined(Pre(g),Actual(node,s)) and Pre(g,Actual(node,s))

families.coverage: one callee execution couples complete result product and output state
families.reject: combine results and effects from distinct calls or import unproved contracts
families.signature: forall e,s,o. ReachCall(f,node,e,s) and Run(g,Actual(node,s),s,o) -> JointCall(node,s,o)

families.coverage: conditional on actual reached arguments; only required by total callers
families.reject: promote a partial callee to globally total or add recursive theorem cycles
families.signature: forall e,s. ReachCall(f,node,e,s) -> exists o. Run(g,Actual(node,s),s,o) and Normal(o)

families.coverage: registered compiler/symbol/body/target and full precondition/effect relation
families.reject: trust a package name, caller adapter, mismatched body or target
families.signature: RegisteredExactAdapter(node) and forall a,s,o. SourceAdapter(node,a,s,o) iff AdapterModel(node,a,s,o)

families.coverage: exact control stack and continuation; distinct yield/return/break/continue
families.reject: change an abrupt exit target or discard an enclosing post step

families.coverage: first header after initializer and range capture; candidate invariant checked
families.reject: assume even a generated invariant before its initialization proof
families.signature: forall e,s. ReachFirstHeader(f,loop,e,s) -> DefinedInv(loop,e,s) and Inv(loop,e,s)

families.coverage: all continuing backedges including continue with the correct post
families.reject: require decrease on return/break or skip the post on continue
families.signature: forall e,h,k. Inv(loop,e,h) and ContinuingIteration(loop,h,k) -> DefinedInv(loop,e,k) and Inv(loop,e,k)

families.coverage: false test, break and early return keep their own guards/continuations
families.reject: infer a false test at break or ignore result/effect propagation
families.signature: forall e,h,o. Inv(loop,e,h) and ExitingIteration(loop,h,o) -> ExitRelation(loop,e,h,o)

families.coverage: well-founded Nat rank after exact signed/full-word conversion
families.reject: use wrapped machine subtraction or an unproved nonnegative assumption
families.signature: forall e,h. ReachVariantHeader(loop,e,h) -> Defined(V,e,h) and NatRank(V,e,h)

families.coverage: strict decrease only on continuing edges; exact source loop binding
families.reject: accept equal/wrapped ranks or borrow another loop's variant
families.signature: forall e,h,k. Inv(loop,e,h) and ContinuingIteration(loop,h,k) -> Rank(V,e,k) < Rank(V,e,h)

materialized_expansion.condition: independently regenerate complete context/definitions/member list and source correspondence types; all requests elaborated; no unresolved candidate; source and IR well-formedness computed, never supplied as hypotheses
materialized_expansion.skeleton: existing common root, Go kind, theorem_declarations are exact ordered required_theorems projected to request_hash,name,declaration_hash; source_vc_hash binds the full assembly and binding

policy.AI_rule: complete policy-owned property list, all batches and global aliases; projected prose cannot supply status, target, declaration, proof, context or source authority
policy.checked_rule: identical final certificate bytes accepted by both checkers; same checked foundation imports and exact context prefix/statement/manifest; Go zero axioms; exact fully discharged dependency DAG
policy.pending_rule: unelaborated != materialized pending != candidate rejected != resource pending; no admitted source/profile claim from metadata
policy.required_set: every request exactly once; grouping is presentation only; no omitted source/frame/definedness/call/loop member
policy.retained_policy_rule: dispatch compiled exact context policy: zero-axiom Go remains zero; retained mvp-theory allowlists, formats and five axiom categories remain unchanged; fixture-specific paired_certificate zero check is not the generic retained policy

source_binding.hash_preimage: all fields except binding_hash; assembly precedes binding; neither root establishes that its theorem is proved
